शाटी—पट्टिक n.
शाटी—पिच्छक n.
शाटी—प्रच्छद n. g. गवाश्वादि.

s: puM, vastraBedaH । ityamaraBaratO ॥ yaTA, -- “dUrataH SoBate mUrKo lambaSAwapawAvftaH । tAvacca SoBate mUrKo yAvat kiYcinna BAzate ॥” iti cARakyaSatakam ॥
v: pu॰ Sawa--TaY । vastre amaraH । strItvamapi gOrA॰ NIz ।
m: शाट m. (fr. √ शट्?) a strip of cloth, a kind of skirt or petticoat, a partic. sort of garment or gown, Vas.; Cāṇ.
a: शाटः, शाटी — 1 A garment, cloth. --2 A petticoat.

s: puM klI, (SAwa + svArTe kan .) pawaH । (yaTA, kaTAsaritsAgare । 53 । 38 । “sa rAjavandinAmA taddattvA SAwakamagrahIt ॥”) nAwakaBedaH । ityamaraBaratO ॥
v: pu॰ na॰ Sawa--Rvul । vastre amaraH strItvamapi wAp ।
m: शाटक m. n. = शाट, Kāv.; Kathās. &c.
शाटि f. id., SaddhP.
शाटिका f. id., Divyāv.
शाट्यायनी f. N. of an Upaniṣad
शाट्यायनीयोपनिषद् f. N. of an Upaniṣad.

s: klI, prakftakarmmavEguRyapraSamanATahomaH । yaTA । yattu prakftakarmmavEguRyapraSamanAya SAwyAyanahomABiDAnaM BavadevaBawwasammataM tanna prAmARikaM tasmAdapi mahAprAmARikErBawwanArAyaRacaraRErgoBilaBAzye tadapramARIkftatvAt । CandogapariSizwe'pi prAyaScittArTaM prakAratrayamAtramuktam । yaTA, -- “yatra vyAhftiBirhomaH prAyaScittAtmako Bavet । catasrastatra vijYeyA strIpARigrahaRe yaTA ॥ api vAjYAtamityezA prAjApatyApi bAhutiH । hotavyA trirvvikalpo'yaM prAyaScittaviDiH smftaH ॥” trirvvikalpa ityanena kalpAntaranizeDAt goBilIyakarmmaRi SAwyAyanahomo na yuktaH । kintu vyastasamastamahAvyAhftiBiScatasfBiH prAyaScittahomo yuktaH । viSAradapraBftayo'pyevam । SAwyAyanahomasya samUlatve'pi SAKyantarIyatvam । iti tiTyAditattvam ॥
v: pu॰ 1 muniBede, tena proktam aR । 2 prakftahomakarmaRi vEguRyasamADanArTaM vihite homaBede na॰ BavadavaH ।
m: शाट्यायन m. (patr. fr. शाट्य) N. of a teacher and author of various works (see below)
pl. ‘the followers of Śāṭyāyana’, ĀśvGṛ.; R. &c.
शाट्यायन n. an oblation for remedying anything wrong in the performance of an act or rite (cf. -होम)
शाट्यायन mf(ई)n. of or belonging to Ś˚ or the Ś˚, MW.
a: शाट्यायनं — An oblation for remedying anything wrong in the performance of a rite.

m: शाट्यायन—ब्राह्मण n. the Brāhmaṇa of Ś˚, ŚrS.
शाट्यायन—गोत्र n. the family of Ś˚, R.
शाट्यायन—होम m. N. of a partic. oblation (cf. above), Tithyād.
शाट्यायनक n. the Brāhmaṇa of Śāṭyāyana or a passage from it, ŚrS.
शाट्यायन—स्मृति f. the law-book of Ś˚, Hcat.
शाट्यायनि m. patr. of the author of a law-book, ŚBr. (cf. g. तिकादि).
शाट्यायनिन् m. pl. the followers of Śāṭyāyana (N. of a Śākhā of the Yajur-veda), Lāṭy.; Sāy.
शाट्यायन्य्-उपनिषद् f. id.
शाट्य mfn. born in Śaṭa g. शण्डिकादि
patr. fr. शत, g. गर्गादि.
